newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Melon to issue 136 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Thai Melon to issue 136 mln new shares.

text.p: Thai Melon Polyester Plc said on Friday it will raise registered capital by 1.36 billion baht ($52.3 million) to 2.9 billion baht by issuing 136 million new shares.

Of the total new shares, 46 million will be offered to existing shareholders through the three-for-one rights issue at 10 baht each, the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET).
The allocation of the remaining 90 million shares will be determined later by the company's board, the company said.
Proceeds from the capital increase will be used to buy new machinery and invest in a new fibre line, it said.
Thai Melon, listed in the textile sector, is a major producer of polyester fibre.
